questions.stem: What is a key limitation of using a potometer to investigate transpiration?

options.text: It can only measure transpiration in darkness
It can only measure one factor at a time
It uses a cut shoot, which may not behave exactly like a whole plant
It destroys the plant's xylem tissue

questions.explanation: Using a cut shoot means the plant lacks roots and may behave differently from an intact plant. Also, the potometer measures water uptake, which is not exactly the same as transpiration.
